description: Angular component template for configuring time interval options, including checkboxes, translation bindings, and nested components for interval grouping.

methods.name: getIndeterminate
methods.description: Returns whether the interval checkbox is in an indeterminate state.

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Returns whether the interval checkbox is checked.

methods.name: enableDisableIntervals
methods.description: Enables or disables interval options based on checkbox state.

methods.name: trackByElement
methods.description: Tracks interval elements for ngFor rendering.

methods.name: minAggInterval
methods.description: Calculates minimum aggregation interval based on current interval value.

methods.name: maxAggInterval
methods.description: Calculates maximum aggregation interval based on current interval value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the form to default state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Applies the changes made in the form.
